buildings currently Camp Hopson department store, Newbury 1594-1967 (D/EX2669) Cambridgeshire Archives Netherhall Tyndalls in Soham with Fordham manorial court books 1522-1780 (R117/035) St Georges in Kingston manorial court roll (1588-1593) and deeds of property in Fordham 1413 and Wood Ditton 1573 1413-1593 (R117/040) Canterbury Cathedral Archives and Library Map of the Mote, near Canterbury 1635 (Map/227) Centre for Buckinghamshire Studies Letters patent of Mary I granting the former Snelshall Priory and land in Whaddon to Edmund Ashfield 1554 (AR 32/2017) Cheshire Archives and Local Studies Martinscroft family: deeds and papers rel to the family incl inquisition on rights of fisherman at Thelwall, 1401 and surveys of Crab Hall 1401-1833 (D 8984) Morton of Little Morton Estate: pedigree roll c 1600 (D9006) Cornwall Record Office Petitions and papers with arguments for and against Penryn becoming a coinage town, originating from Penryn and other Cornish towns 1682-1732 (AD2509) Cumbria Archive Centre, Carlisle Anne Clifford (1590-1676), Baroness Clifford, wife of 4th Earl of Pembroke: corresp and other family papers 1540s-1676 (DDIG1) Cumbria Archive Centre, Kendal The Skipton set, Great Books of Record: three volumes of Veteripont and Clifford family history and transcripts of records c1649-1652 (WDHOTH/1/29) Derbyshire Record Office Sir Joseph Paxton (1801-1865), politician, architect and landscape gardener: deeds, abstracts of title and other papers rel to his Matlock and Derbyshire estates c1618-1899 (D8074) Dorset History Centre Batten & Co, solicitors, Chard and Yeovil: additional Batten family papers, primarily deeds and some rentals 1400-1900 (D-BTT) East Sussex Record Office Harrison family of Sutton Place: records incl the diary and commonplace book of Thomas Harison of Sutton Place, 1795 1650-2000 (12979) Lawson Lewis Blakers, solicitors: deeds of Wilbees in Arlington, 1654-1923, and of Providence Chapel, Lewes, 1664-1968 1654-1968 (12818) Rooks, Rider & Co, solicitors: deeds of Broadreed Farm, Mayfield 1590-1770 (12806) Essex Record Office Ashdon Hall manor: court rolls 1518-1602 (non consecutive), court books and draft court books 1710-1916, minute books 1710-1882 non-consecutive and a rental 1697 1518-1916 (A14754) Lawford Hall and Lawford Sayes manorial court rolls, rentals and stewards' papers; Lawford parish papers, receipts for rates and accounts; deeds and papers rel to Lawford and marriage settlements rel to Green family of Lawford 1569-1869 (A14693) Coggeshall deeds 1427-1574 (A14759) Map of Whitehouse Farm,
